description: Reduction constants. Defaults are the v0.2 protocol values.

director_mode.description: principal_axis (axis, mod pi) or supply_demand (vector, mod 2 pi; PROPOSED).
director_mode.title: Director Mode

director_ratio_min.description: principal_axis: node valid only if lambda1/lambda2 >= this.
director_ratio_min.title: Director Ratio Min

k.description: Neighbours per node for patches and links (union kNN).
k.title: K

orientation_convention.description: Fixes each component's frame orientation so holonomy signs are invariant.
orientation_convention.title: Orientation Convention

planarity_min.description: Node valid only if lambda2/lambda3 >= this.
planarity_min.title: Planarity Min

reliability_min.description: Link kept only if the smallest singular value of O_i^T O_j >= this.
reliability_min.title: Reliability Min

supersaturation_threshold.description: Local/global density ratio marking a supersaturated operand.
supersaturation_threshold.title: Supersaturation Threshold

title: GaugeParams
